serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I received a message. It’s from the blog page...
It looks like it has a hidden chat feature.
Let’s see what they sent me…
Little_Richard: Hello AbusedTenant!
That’s the username I used on the website… Kind of regret it now.
Little_Richard: If you read the recent blog, you should already know that every new member gets orders from a squad leader, right?
AbusedTenant: Yeah, I read about it.
Little_Richard: For safety reasons you are not allowed to know anything about other members of our squad, ok? So don’t ask about other members in the blog’s comment section! That’s an easy way to get banned.
AbusedTenant: Sure.
Little_Richard: Do you have any questions? 
AbusedTenant: No, I don’t think so.
Little_Richard: You are not very talkative, aren’t you?
I-Is he suspicious of me already?!
AbusedTenant: Sorry about that.
Little_Richard: Don’t worry, I didn’t mean anything bad!
Little_Richard: But you should consider yourself lucky. I’m not overly suspicious like other squad leaders. Some of them get nervous really quick, especially around new guys.
AbusedTenant: I can understand why…
Little_Richard: Don’t worry! So far not many of us got caught and most of them got done for only because they were bragging about joining us on not secure communicators. 
Huh?! That’s enough to get caught?!
I guess it’s a good thing all my internet friends are rarely online these days…
I hate growing up…
Little_Richard: Why aren’t you answering? Did I scare you?
Little_Richard: Just to reassure you, none of the members serving under me ever got caught! 
Little_Richard: And it’s not like we are doing anything bad really. It’s just this current government doing everything to stop inevitable changes.
Little_Richard: Once Admin’s AI takes over, we are gonna free everyone who’s in jail over some bullshit charges!
‘...it’s not like we are doing anything bad…’? What does he mean?
Big Daddy told me they are dangerous terrorists, that they released a nerve agent and even killed a member of the House…
It’s not like I don’t trust Big Daddy, but it wouldn’t hurt to try to probe this Richard guy a little…
AbusedTenant: Thanks for reassuring me. I had some doubts before because of that member of the House thing, but now I’m fully committed
Little_Richard: Member of the House? What do you mean?
Yes! He took the bait!
AbusedTenant: I read somewhere on the news that you guys did some terrorist attack and killed some important people
Little_Richard: What?! That’s total bs!
Little_Richard: Where did you read about it? Bang News? Did you know they are state sponsored?
AbusedTenant: No, I didn’t know.
Little_Richard: One news outlet is fact checking the other and in the end it turns out that they are owned by the same company! You can’t trust anyone these days! 
Little_Richard: Listen, no one from our organization would do something like this! As far as I know, the plan is to use a powerful AI to paralyze and take over all the federal internet networks, services and banking! Then even people of the state would have no way to fight against the new system and would need to be compliant with it!
What?
Am I getting bamboozled? 
If they didn’t kill the member of the House, then who did? 
Nothing’s adding up…
Little_Richard: Well, I got a little ahead of myself and talked too much. It was supposed to be a secret, I guess! 
Little_Richard: So please, don’t talk about it to anyone, especially on the blog. Some of the guys there are ruthless and would want you to be banned over even a little thing. That’s why I’m not really active there.
AbusedTenant: Thanks for the advice
Little_Richard: No problem! 
Little_Richard: Anyway, let’s wait a little for the new orders. If you have any questions, you are free to ask!
Little_Richard: See ya!
AbusedTenant: Bye.
Now I’m really confused…
Let’s not contact Big Daddy about this yet. I need to learn some more information first.
Who’s lying to me? Big Daddy or Little Richard? Or maybe they are just misinformed? I need to find out before I make my decision…
